mapper.select: select sum(money) from user_money_details where user_id = #{userId} and classify = 4 and type = 2 and state = 2 and date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{date}, '%Y-%m')
select * from user_money_details where user_id = #{userId} and type = 2

SELECT u.user_id, u.avatar, u.nick_name, IF(u.divide_scale = 0 || u.divide_two_scale = 0, 0, 1) AS isAgent, SUM(money - IFNULL((SELECT SUM(money)FROM user_money_details md WHERE md.relation_id = d.relation_id AND md.classify = 5),0))AS money FROM user_money_details d, tb_user u WHERE u.user_id = d.user_id AND classify = 2 GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY money DESC

SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.avatar, u.user_name as userName, SUM(money) AS money FROM user_money_details d, tb_user u WHERE d.relation_id = u.user_id AND d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.user_level =#{type} GROUP BY d.relation_id ORDER BY money DESC
